title: X.Vilitur Gloss White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Nexx X.Vilitur Gloss White is engineered for seamless transitions between open-face city stops and full-face highway cruising, delivering flip-up versatility for city stops and sealed protection at speed. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing 1621g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~87 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with pressure-relief temple channels and contoured removable cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Nexx X.Vilitur Gloss White: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Nexx X.Vilitur Gloss White: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Nexx X.Vilitur Gloss White. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Nexx's Modular lineup, the X.Vilitur Gloss White brings Portuguese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Nexx X.Vilitur Gloss White represents Nexx's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Nexx X.Vilitur Gloss White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
